text:
jordan: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we had a page storm overnight from the storage-cleanup job. Root cause: noisy retries + low threshold + no grouping. Need a short plan (owners + dates) so this doesn't recur.

maria: I pulled the page metrics — ~120 pages in a 10m window, 85% were duplicates. My suggestion: raise threshold, add grouping/dedupe, and a short silence window for scheduled jobs.

kevin: Action list proposal (I can own 1):
1) storage-cleanup-failure alert: increase threshold from 3 -> 15 failures per 10m. owner: kevin. due: 2025-01-12. PR will reference ticket SINF-342.
2) Alertmanager grouping/dedupe: group by ['alertname','job'] + group_interval 5m. owner: jordan. due: 2025-01-10.
3) Scheduled-job silence policy: auto-silence for known maintenance cron windows. owner: sara. due: 2025-01-09.
4) Runbook + postmortem follow-up doc: add remediation steps and runbook playbook. owner: nora. due: 2025-01-14.
I'll create the tickets after this thread and ping the owners.

sara: I can implement the silence policy. Need the exact cron for the cleanup job (so I can set the window +/-2m). cron is: `0 3 * * *` right?

maria: yes that's the one. Also, upstream ingestion dedupe can collapse identical alerts within 2m; that would cut duplicates before they hit Alertmanager. owner: maria. due: 2025-01-11.

jordan: sample Alertmanager grouping snippet I think we should add:```
group_by: ['alertname', 'job']
group_wait: 30s
group_interval: 5m
repeat_interval: 1h
```

maria: +1 to that config. Also recommend a short backoff on retries in the cleanup job to avoid cascade.

ops-bot: Ticket created: SINF-342 - "storage-cleanup noisy alerts" -> https://boards.redwood.internal/SINF-342

nora: I'll take the runbook edits. Plan: add explicit remediation steps, example commands, and when to escalate to infra. I'll link the updated runbook to the ticket.

kevin: I'll open the PR for the threshold change and include a small benchmark in the description showing false-positive reduction. Will ping reviewers @jordan @maria. :thumbsup:

jordan: Quick decision check — do we want a hard dedupe (drop duplicates) or probabilistic (collapse but keep a summary)? My vote: collapse with count in the message so humans still see total volume.

maria: collapse + count is ideal. We can add `dedupe_window: 2m` in the ingestion pipeline and keep Alertmanager grouping for aggregation.

sara: I'll add the silence automation to run 2m before and 2m after the cron job window. Will post a small PR to ops-config.

jordan: Great. I'll schedule a 15m sync to confirm infra changes and review PRs — Wed 10:00am PST. If any owner needs different assignment or timeline, shout now.

kevin: fine for me.

nora: okay.

maria: sounds good. I'll also add a small monitoring dashboard panel for duplicate rate so we can watch after changes.

jordan: Thanks team — marking this resolved in the postmortem follow-up doc and will move the tickets to "in progress".
